name: C6-N8
description: C6-N8 was a protocol droid active during the Cold War. It could be found on Alderaan. In 3643 BBY, the droid tasked a traveling Republic affiliated individual with helping its master, Selia Antares, defuse a House Ulgo bomb on a transport ship. The hero succeeded, and was able to return the defusal codes to Antares.
